title: GPU picker: a measured Gen speed bar replaces the spec-sheet TFLOPS bar
description: The picker's speed bar is vendor spec-sheet FP16 TFLOPS, which misranks cards for ComfyUI (H100 SXM at 990 TFLOPS loses SDXL to a 5090 at 419; A100 at 312 is slower than a PRO 4500 at 203). RunPod publishes measured ComfyUI seconds per image per card (runpod.io/gpu-compare, Secure Cloud, Jul-Sep 2026); neither REST v2 nor GraphQL carries any speed field. Krea2 is not benchmarked; FLUX.2 Klein 9B bf16 is the closest proxy (similar size, Flux lineage, fits 24 GB like our fp8 Krea2), so the bar ranks cards by it. Fabio 2026-10-01: option A, green bar (was --accent-frost, which reads as the Audio mascot's colour), labelled Gen speed. A Video bar from RunPod's LTX-2.3 numbers follows when they publish (Coming Soon on 2026-10-01). Cards RunPod did not benchmark show no bar.
